pages.title: Spring and Hook
pages.text: Grappling and bouncing help cross broken terrain.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A sharpened-cane hook crosses gaps; dual hooks reduce delay. Sweetish Fish gelatin and Sundrops make boots that bounce on landing.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Chocolate, cake, Purple Soda and Licoroot form edible terrain without making monsters friendly. Caramel Cubes split; small ones yield caramel and puddles briefly slow movement.
